newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks close lower on rates, properties worries.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks close lower on rates, properties worries.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks gave up small early gains to close Thursday moderately down, chiefly due to weakness in the outlook for property developers and a reassessment of the interest rate outlook, brokers said.
"The volatility in the market today is a symptom of investors's unease over interest rates and inflationary expectations," said Julian Ings Chambers, sales director at BZW Securities Asia.
The Hang Seng Index closed 65.08 points lower at 12,516.23, well off the day's high of 12,635.52. Turnover was respectable at HK$8.30 billion, but down from Wednesday's HK$10.15 billion.
